title: Training credit for cover shifts
titleZh: 支援輪班的訓練時數認列
passage:
Harbor House | Training credit notice
The new one-hour safety briefing can be attended live or watched as a replay. If you attend live, the trainer enters your name. If you use the replay, submit the quiz from your training account; opening the replay alone does not count.
A cover shift is a shift you work for another team. Training done during a cover shift belongs on your usual team’s record, not the host team’s record. Check your record the next morning. If an entry is missing, send the completion date and briefing title to the training desk. Do not ask both supervisors to enter it.
For staff due to cover the loading counter, there is a separate access rule. Anyone without recorded training may cover the customer desk but not the loading counter. If your credit is missing, the host supervisor can change your assignment for that shift; the supervisor cannot approve training credit. The training desk will still need the information above.
passageZh:
港灣館｜訓練時數認列
新的一小時安全說明可參加現場場次，也可觀看錄影。參加現場時，由講師登記姓名；看錄影則須用自己的訓練帳號交測驗。光打開錄影不算完成。
支援輪班是指代其他團隊值班。支援期間完成的訓練，應記在原所屬團隊的紀錄，不是受支援團隊。請在隔天早上檢查紀錄。若少了某筆，請把完成日期與說明會名稱寄給訓練服務台。不要請兩位主管各登記一次。
即將支援裝貨服務台者另有一條工作限制。未登記訓練者可支援顧客服務台，但不能支援裝貨服務台。若缺漏訓練時數，受支援團隊主管可調整你那一班的工作，但不能批准認列訓練時數。訓練服務台仍然需要前段所列資訊。
